A private guide and air-conditioned vehicle are included throughout.

inclusions.text: Entrance to the Giza Plateau (in the entrance-fee tiers of this tour)
inclusions.source: Entrance to the plateau itself is included in the entrance-fee tiers of this tour; entrance to the interiors of the pyramids is not, and involves additional fees paid on-site (the chambers are narrow, steep, and warm — worth knowing before committing).

inclusions.text: Sphinx enclosure (in the general plateau ticket)
inclusions.source: The Sphinx enclosure is included in the general plateau ticket.

exclusions.source: This tour does not include GEM entry, but your guide can advise on whether a self-funded stop is realistic given your timing.

exclusions.text: Entrance to the interiors of the pyramids (additional fees paid on-site)
exclusions.source: Entrance to the plateau itself is included in the entrance-fee tiers of this tour; entrance to the interiors of the pyramids is not, and involves additional fees paid on-site (the chambers are narrow, steep, and warm — worth knowing before committing).

exclusions.text: Camel and horse rides (at your own expense)
exclusions.source: Camel and horse rides are offered independently by operators at the site; your guide can advise, but these are entirely at your own expense and discretion.
